reviews.review: I've been playing this game for years & it's the only consistent game I play. I try to play at least the daily game & participate in the wknd tournaments when I can. reviews.title: Great app, but…
reviews.review: This app is great overall. It’s very easy to use, as well as appropriately challenging. However, there are a few things that irked me about it. The first thing is that hints cost an unholy amount of coins. 100 coins may seem like a good deal at first - but if you find, say, five hidden words per level per set, that’s 16x5 = 80.
